title: Collections Administration | Commercial Delinquency Management | Veteran Loan Servicing
description: Commercial loan collections administration: delinquency tracking from first missed payment through structured recovery, documented in the servicing trail.
lede: Commercial collections is not consumer debt collection. It is disciplined delinquency management for institutional loans — tracked from the first missed payment through structured recovery.

sections.heading: Process
paragraphs: Delinquency is tracked from the first missed payment. Accounts move through a defined sequence — notice, follow-up, escalation — with each step documented, and into workout or default administration when terms are broken.
bullets: Delinquency flagged at first missed payment

sections.heading: Controls
paragraphs: The collections sequence is defined rather than improvised, and every step is recorded in the servicing trail — the documentation lenders, examiners, and workout counsel need.

sections.heading: Reporting
paragraphs: Delinquency status and collection activity appear in portfolio reporting so lenders see which accounts are off-plan and what has been done about it.

sections.heading: Benefits
paragraphs: Catching delinquency early and documenting the response shortens time-to-signal and preserves the lender's recovery options.

faqs.a: No. This is commercial delinquency management for institutional loans — commercial real estate and business/commercial loans only, not consumer debt.
Delinquency is tracked from the first missed payment, with a defined notice-and-escalation sequence documented in the servicing trail.
Accounts move into workout or default administration, including remedies available under UCC Article 9 where applicable.
